# Smitten with the Muses – David Rivera

> Smitten with the Muses (2014) is a piano-led album by David Rivera, American composer. Free printable piano scores with chords are on Lackadaisical Perfection.

## Album
- [Smitten with the Muses](https://smittenwiththemuses.com/): the album page, with tracks and listen links.

## Tracks
1. Flowing Spontaneity
2. Flying Freedom
3. Beguiling Dance
4. Tranquil Wisdom

7. Cautious Belief
8. Unforgettable Disquiet
9. Playful Trek
10. Happy Reawakening
11. Loquacious Daydream
12. Loony Joyfulness
13. Indelible Memory
14. Fantastical Present
15. Dark Divinity
16. Pure Freedom
